test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The compound interest on a sum of Rs. 8,000 becomes Rs. 1,261 in 18 months. Find the rate of interest if interest is compounded half-yearly.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 8,000

Compound Interest (CI) = Rs. 1,261

Time (T) = 18 months = 1.5 years

Interest is compounded half-yearly

**Formula Used:**

CI = P(1 + r/n)ⁿt - P

Where,

P = Principal amount

r = annual interest rate

n = number of times interest is compounded per year

t = time in years

**Calculation:**

Given CI = Rs. 1,261
